info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package standing prices and tracks what it costs to KEEP a company, as distinct from what it cost to form one.

post.summary: Reports what keeping this entity costs every year, itemised.
post.description:
Reports what keeping this entity costs every year, itemised.

This is the figure that decides where to incorporate, and the one a formation
price cannot show: Delaware is cheaper to form than Wyoming for a corporation
and dearer to keep, so a founder shown only the formation fee is shown the half
that reverses. Each state line carries the authority that publishes it and the
date it was checked, and a franchise tax that scales is marked a minimum rather
than quoted as final.

amountCents.description: AmountCents is what it costs each period.

asOf.description: AsOf is when that amount was last checked against its source, RFC 3339 date.

code.description: Code names the obligation so a caller can branch without reading prose.

every.description: Every is how often it falls due — "yearly" for every obligation known here.

label.description: Label is what the payer sees.

minimum.description:
Minimum marks a floor rather than a fixed price — a franchise tax that
scales with shares or assets is quoted at its minimum, and an entity past
the threshold owes more. Saying so is the difference between a quote and a
number someone later disputes.

passThrough.description: PassThrough marks money we collect and remit to the state rather than keep.

source.description:
Source names the authority that publishes a pass-through amount, so the
figure can be checked without first working out who would know.

stale.description:
Stale reports that AsOf is older than the review window. It tells; it does
not block.

atLeast.description:
AtLeast reports that some obligation is a minimum, so YearlyCents is a floor
rather than a final figure.

currency.description: Currency is the ISO code every amount here is denominated in.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction is the state whose obligations these are.

obligations.description: Obligations are the recurring charges, in the order a reader should see them.

structure.description: Structure is the entity this prices.

yearlyCents.description: YearlyCents is what the entity owes every year, all obligations summed.

agentOfRecord.description: AgentOfRecord includes our agent fee, which most entities owe someone.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction is the state the entity stands in.

structure.description: Structure is the entity kind: c-corp, llc or dao-llc.

bearer.description: The caller's credential, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It is either an access token minted by Hanzo IAM or an API key (pk-/sk-). X-Authorization, and HTTP Basic carrying the token as the password, are accepted spellings of the same header for clients that cannot set Authorization; a browser presents the session cookie instead. Every operation requires it unless it says `security: []`.
